name: Solaris 9
tagline: CDE backdrops and the violet field behind an iconic Solaris watermark.
description: Solaris 9 shipped with CDE as its default desktop environment. CDE treats the workspace surface as a selectable Backdrop rather than a freely chosen background color, and several of its bundled Backdrops are solid fields. This palette records those colors, along with the solid violet beneath the watermark of the default SolarisLogo Backdrop.

colors.name: Midnight Violet
colors.note: The solid color used by the CDE Backdrop named “Background”.

colors.name: Amethyst
colors.note: The solid color used by the CDE Backdrop named “Foreground”.

colors.name: Dove Gray
colors.note: The solid color used by the CDE Backdrop named “Gray”.

colors.name: Granite Gray
colors.note: The darker solid gray used by the CDE Backdrop named “GrayDk”.

colors.name: Frost Gray
colors.note: The lighter solid gray used by the CDE Backdrop named “GrayLt”.

colors.name: Black
colors.note: Associated with CDE’s “NoBackdrop” option, which leaves the Backdrop transparent and exposes the root window beneath it.

colors.name: Iris
colors.note: The solid violet field behind the watermark in the iconic default “SolarisLogo” Backdrop; the watermark is omitted here.
